description: This file defines the CameraActivity class, which extends Activity, serving as a shell that hosts the CameraFragment in an Android application. It primarily sets the theme based on intent extras and loads a layout resource.

classes.name: CameraActivity
classes.description: A basic activity that hosts a camera fragment and sets theme and layout during creation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes the activity, sets the theme based on intent extras, and sets the content view.
